High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Pradeep
Naveriya - Advocate for appellant.
Shri Pramod Choubey - Govt. Advocate for the State.
Appellant has filed I.A. No.11611/2024 an application under Section 389 (1) of Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of jail sentence.

Appellant has been convicted for offences under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and section 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for maximum period of ten years with total fine of Rs.13,000/-, with default stipulations.
It is submitted by learned counsel for appellant that prosecutrix was more than 17 years of age.
She was a consenting party, which is evident from her deposition given in the Court.
Appellant is also a young man aged about 25 years.
He is in jail since last about five years.
Considering the aforesaid circumstance, application for suspension of sentence be allowed and he may be granted bail.
Learned Govt. Advocate for the State opposed the application.
It is submitted that offence is serious in nature.
Appellant is having criminal antecedents of two other cases of similar nature.
Hence, he may not be granted bail.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Learned counsel appearing for appellant has filed copies of order dated 2 CRA-9961-2022 13.01.2023 passed in Special Case No.72/2019 in which appellant was acquitted and also in Special Case No.14/2017, he was acquitted.
Considering the age of appellant, prosecutrix and also taking into consideration the deposition of prosecutrix recorded in the Court, said I.A. is allowed.

It is directed that the custodial sentence awarded to the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal subject to deposit of fine, if not already deposited and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 13.12.2024 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard till final disposal of this appeal.
